svg.title: LineaForge Studio — technical ecosystem and all 28 P&ID agent roles
svg.desc: Editable technical architecture diagram. React calls FastAPI. One orchestrator coordinates the sequential P&ID pipeline using configured VLM and LLM providers and shared evidence. Human-reviewed graph snapshots feed one deterministic CAD builder, which selects offline DXF or MCP and Windows native CAD. CAD QA and human release review precede final reporting. All 28 catalog roles are named with their execution kinds.
svg.text: Full technical ecosystem · all 28 P&ID roles · configured models · reviewed CAD execution
